name: Side-Notes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Fixes
- Export to PDF skipped some sidenotes if a margin note was presence. The margin note marker was taking the spot of a regular sidenote when being counted by Obsidian. 
- Various linter warnings that didn't seem to cause problems but should probably be fixed anyway

## Note
The plugin has been renamed **Side-Notes** because another plugin exists in the Community Plugins called Sidenotes. It doesn't seem to be listed at this time but it still prevents me from adding mine.

IMPORTANT: Make sure you rename your plugin folder to **side-notes** if you have not already.
releases.name: 0.4.3 - Fix export to PDF issue, fix linter warnings

releases.name: 0.4.0 - Rename to Side-Notes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
**Fixes:**
- **PDF export with HTML sidenotes**: It was showing the sidenote text in the main content of the exported file. Now it properly hides this while displaying the sidenotes properly.
- **Source Mode with Footnotes**: It was still displaying sidenotes in the margin. Now it hides these in favor of showing the bare Markdown content.

New:
- **PDF export with footnotes**: PDF export now works with both HTML sidenotes and footnotes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Fixes:

- Collision detection
- Fixes font size issues with sidenotes and margin notes. Previously, if a sidenote was added to a header it made the font size larger. This also appied to popup margin notes.
releases.name: 0.3.8 - Updated collision detection

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
This release updates the logic that controls how sidenotes are positioned relative to the note text and edges of the editor window. 

It should better stick to whichever edge you set it to anchor to. Either it **anchors to the text** or **anchors to the editor edge** and it should do either one better now.
releases.name: 0.3.7 - Positioning fixes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Fixes:
- Some of the logic around how sidenotes position themselves as the editor changes size. 
  - There were edge cases where sidenotes were not positioning themselves properly. For example, when loading Obsidian and a note with sidenotes opens with it - the sidenotes would only correctly position themselves once clicking into the note.
  - In Reading Mode, the resize observer was lagging causing it to be less responsive to the editor resizing.
releases.name: 0.3.6 - Bug fixes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Adds:
- Margin note popup starts read only. When once clicks into the text it becomes editable. This makes links clickable.
- Setting `Margin note popup icon scale factor` for scaling the icon that shows in the margin for a margin note popup
- Setting `Margin note marker scale factor` for scaling the icon in the main text marking a margin note

Fix:
- Issue causing cursor to not move past margin note markers and preventing from adding a space after the markers.
releases.name: 0.3.5 - Margin note popup updates

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Adds:
- Custom Unicode character or image name for margin note popup icons
  - To use an image, store it in `plugins/sidenotes/assets`. Supply the image filename in the settings field "Margin note popup icon". 
  - I've packaged one image with the plugin in the .ZIP file that can be used for this. It is called `information_source.png`.


EDIT: Minor fix for some CSS issues. Replaced the release files.
releases.name: 0.3.4 - Margin note icon customizability

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description: Fixes the "Insert margin note" command
releases.name: 0.3.3 - Bug fix

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Adds:
- Option where, when enabled, an icon is shown where margin notes go. When clicked, the margin notes shows in a popup. In Editing Mode, the margin note can be edited inside the popup. For now, the icon is set to ⓘ but more options or a custom field may be used in the future.
releases.name: 0.3.2 - Adds optional icon for margin notes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Added:
- Command *Resequence footnotes* to re-number footnotes sequentially. When adding sidenotes it's easy for these to start getting out of order. This command should clean that up. It will leave margin notes alone.

Fixed:
- Hides "neumorphic badge" or "pill badge" for margin notes when either those styles are enabled
releases.name: 0.3.1 - New command "Resequence footnotes"

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Fixes:
- Makes negative values possible for gap drift factor
releases.name: 0.3.0 - Gap Drift Factor revision

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
**Adds**
- **Margin Notes**: Non-numbered notes in the margin. Use command `Insert margin note` to start one.
- A setting called **Gap Drift Factor**: Controls how much sidenotes will move away from the note text as the editor size increases horizontally. This just lets the sidenotes fill in some space a little more organically if set properly.
releases.name: 0.2.9 - Margin Notes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Adds:
- option to integrate sidenotes into a PDF export - for HMTL sidenotes only right now. To make it compatible with footnotes is more difficult. The plugin will have to dynamically add HTML into the document temporarily in the moment PDF export happens for them to be shown as sidenotes. I've tried so far without success so I'll keep experimenting with it.

Fixes:
- HTML sidenotes allows new lines within a sidenote (SHIFT+enter to make a new line). This can't really work with footnotes because of how Markdown footnotes work
- Other minor CSS fixes
releases.name: 0.2.7 - PDF Export compatibility (HTML sidenotes only)

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description: Fixes a bug. After editing a sidenote, if one clicked on the same sidenote, it would show stale content (the text before it was edited). It was updating it but the editor method was getting old cached content.
releases.name: 0.2.6 - Bug fix

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Fixes:
- Issues when saving settings. It wasn't refreshing using the new settings without a restart.
- CSS - works better in Light Mode

Added:
- Optional sidenote text color - defaults to --text-normal otherwise
- Optional sidenote hover color -defaults to --text-accent otherwise

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description: Hopefully this fixes some editing inconsistencies that causes sidenotes to not show as updated after editing, as well as some sidenotes not responding to clicking on them.
releases.name: 0.2.4 - Bug fixes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Fixes:
- Issues with sidenote positioning in long notes.
- Sidenote editor cursor was black (very hard to see) in Editing Mode (HTML sidenotes). Should now use color in common with the theme.
- Issues with sidenotes anchoring to editor edge
- An attempt to fix an issue making sidenote editor text show one letter per line. I haven't been able to replicate this issue but I implemented CSS that theoretically could prevent this. Let me know if you see this persist.

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Added:
- Option to edit sidenotes in Reading Mode

Fixed:
- Issues with visibility and positioning of sidenotes that appeared with longer notes. Obsidian uses "DOM virtualization", meaning it doesn't render the entire note all at once, especially with longer notes. So now it relies on the Markdown file itself as the source of truth. 

If you test it out, let me know if there are any issues.

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Added:
- Realtime Markdown styling in sidenotes while you edit them in the margin.

EDIT: Fixed a line of code that disabled this realtime Markdown styling with footnotes. Fixed now.

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Fixed:
- Editing sidenotes now implements the CodeMirror 6 editor when editing in the margins. This is the same editor Obsidian itself uses so editing should work better with keyboard shortcuts.

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Added:
- Option to show/hide the original footnote references


EDIT: Also fixed an issue where Markdown was not showing when editing footnote/sidenotes in Reading Mode.

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Fixes:
- Editing in margin - there have been some glitchy behavior issues when clicking on a sidenote in the margin and editing. Hopefully this removes some of those issues. It still is very sketchy when you use keyboard shortcuts for Markdown formatting. It's very unreliable at intercepting those.

Added:
- An option to hide or show footnotes at the bottom of the note (only applies if you are using footnotes as the sidenote format)

Margin editing still has some issues. Because it can't intercept keyboard shortcuts well, CTRL+Z (or CMD+Z) doesn't work well to undo. I'm still working on trying to make that more stable.

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
**Added:**
- Better alignment of the sidenotes. This was following the paragraph that the note was added to. Now it follows the specific line of the reference.
- More streamlined way to edit sidenotes when using footnotes, allowing you to click on the sidenote number and start editing it in the margin. This also works in Reading Mode.

**Fixed:** 
- Source Mode works for both footnotes and HTML formatting. Before it didn't work with footnotes.

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
### Added settings option
**Sidenote anchor**: Defines whether it anchor sidenotes to the editor edge or it anchors them to the text.

This option can be set to _"Anchor sidenotes to text"_ or _"Anchor sidenotes to editor"_. 

There are two settings:
- Minimum gap between sidenote and text
- Minimum gap between sidenote and editor edge
releases.name: 0.1.6 - Added style option

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
**Added:**
- One can now choose to use **footnotes** or **HTML spans** to format footnotes. If you prefer working with traditional Markdown footnotes - e.g. [^1], then you can use this mode. This works in both Editing Mode and Reading Mode for either format.

Fixed:
- Markdown processing for foodnote-sidenotes
- Styling for footnotes converted to sidenotes that was causing them to be placed incorrectly
- Fixed some minor CSS styling issues

Just a heads up, I've noticed some slightly glitchy behavior sometimes after changing some style settings. For example, if I change from regular numbers to "neumorphic badge" or "pill" style, at first the numbers don't show up. Or after changing from HTML to footnotes formatting. Often these glitches are temporary resolve themselves by restarting Obsidian. For me, they only seem to happen after changing the style options for the Sidenotes plugin. 

Let me know if your mileage varies though. Any suggestions, feedback, or bug reports welcome.
releases.name: 0.1.5 - Footnotes and Fixes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
EDIT: This release was found to still have some bugs with conversion of footnotes to sidenotes. As far as I know, using sidenotes with HTML works okay. There may be issues with numbers repeating as well. Working on these issues for the next release.

Added:
- Basic Markdown support in sidenotes (**bold**, *italic*, and `inline code`)
- 2 Styles for sidenote numbers (neumorphic badge and pill)
- Option to convert footnotes to sidenotes (Reading Mode Only - a reliable technique for Editing Mode has not been determined yet). Working on make this a more stable feature as it still has some bugs. Because footnotes as sidenotes only works in Reading Mode, there is no way to edit them in Reading Mode.

### Fixed:
- Issues with editing sidenotes in margin. When editing/deleting contents it would reset scroller to the top of the note. Also, it was possible to update the wrong sidenote if two sidenotes had the same contents.
- Numbering consistency. Sometimes numbers would reset after being edited. Sidenote 5 would become labeled 1.
releases.name: 0.1.4 - Markdown support, neumorphic badges, other fixes

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description: Added an Obsidian command `Insert Sidenote` so that it can be hotkeyed.
releases.name: 0.1.3 - Added Obsidian command

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
Added:

- Editing sidenotes in place

Fixed:
- Number incrementing in Reading Mode
- Sidenote collision avoidance in Reading Mode
releases.name: 0.1.1 - Editing in place added

releases.author: cparsell
releases.description:
This is a **Beta release**. Most features that I want are implemented and seem to work. 

Not enough time spent testing so assume there are bugs.
